Tooling release: tag a 0.x of epr-cli and the eprfs crates and flip epr-cli publish = false when the next sprint touches eprfs/epr-cli (workspace-discipline backlog row 3)
Constitution absorbs the clauses the licence states first at its next amendment, reconciling governance-layers-architecture §2 and §4

Before the relying organisation first pins: a dated prior-work notice pointing at the public history
